## Young Adult Green Dragon (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
 LE Huge dragon (air)  
 **Init** +0; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +22; **Aura** frightful presence (150 ft., DC 18)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 24, touch 8, flat-footed 24 (+16 natural, -2 size)  
 **hp** 208 (13d12+52)  
 **Fort** +12, **Ref** +8, **Will** +12  
 **DR** 5/magic; **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep, **SR** 22  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 200 ft. (poor), swim 40 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +19 (2d8+10/19-20), 2 claws +18 (2d6+7/19-20), 2 wings +13 (1d8+3), tail slap +13 (2d6+10)  
 **Space** 15 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (15 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (50-ft. cone, DC 20, 10d6 acid), crush (Small creatures, DC 20, 2d8+10)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 13th; concentration +15)  

  
  At will—
  *[charm person* ](../../magic/spells/charm-person.md)(DC 13),
  *[entangle* ](../../magic/spells/entangle.md)(DC 13)
  
 **Spells Known** (CL 3rd; concentration +5)  

  
  1st (6/day)—
  *[shield](../../magic/spells/shield.md)*,
  *[silent image* ](../../magic/spells/silent-image.md)(DC 13),
  *[summon monster I](../../magic/spells/summon-monster-i.md)*
  

  0 (at will)—
  *[dancing lights](../../magic/spells/dancing-lights.md)*,
  detect magic,
  ghost sound,
  *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*,
  *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*
  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 25, **Dex** 10, **Con** 19, **Int** 14, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 14  
 **Base Atk** +13; **CMB** +22; **CMD** 32 (36 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Alertness, Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Critical (claws), Iron Will, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Fly +8, Knowledge (arcane) +18, Knowledge (nature) +18,  Perception +22, Spellcraft +18, Stealth +8, Survival +18, Swim +31; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim  
 **Languages** Common, Draconic, Elven  
 **SQ** water breathing, woodland stride  

**Special Abilities**

 **Water Breathing (Ex)**  A green dragon can breathe underwater indefinitely and can freely use its breath weapon, spells, and other abilities while submerged.  

 **Woodland Stride (Ex)**  A very young or older green dragon can move through any sort of foliage at full speed without taking damage or suffering impairment. Areas of foliage that have been magically manipulated affect it normally.

  

**Ecology**

 **Environment** temperate forests  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
